wayback._note: The firm published its portfolio from 1999 to 2016 on two mirrored domains, shv.com and sutterhillventures.com, and has shown only a wordmark and its address since 2017. Every era is read by scratch/wayback-eras.py into sources/wayback/parsed/<year>.json with its own capture_url, because none fits the generic era parsers: (1) 1999 to 2000 investments.htm, one table of every investment since 1970 with a description and the firm's own outcome line ('Acquired by Teradyne', 'Public company'); (2) 2000 to 2003 sector pages (software.html, medicaltech.html, networking.html, informationtech.html) linking per-company pages under /soft/, /mt/, /nt/, /it/; (3) 2004 to 2012 sector directories (/software/, /healthcare/, /networking/, /business/, /consumer/, /investment/) with an index page and a page per company; (4) 2013 to 2016 Drupal: /portfolio-full with every company, its description and its managing director, and /portfolio/<sector> filters.

roster._note: Built by scratch/build-roster.py from the archived people pages (2000 to 2016, both domains; name pages like anderson.html and later /team/<surname>.html and /<first-last>), the ADV Schedule A owners (CRD 162959, 2026-03-27), and the related persons who file from the firm's own address on issuers' Form Ds (sources/edgar/formd-address-sweep.json), kept only where a first-party source names the person as the firm's.

edgar._note: Entity-qualified phrases. Sutter Hill Ventures, A California Limited Partnership files ownership forms under CIK 879051; Sutter Hill Entrepreneurs Fund (AI) and (QP), Sutter Hill Associates and Sutter Hill Management Company file Forms 3/4 as co-filers; 1962 Opportunity Fund I, L.P. (CIK 2034518) filed a Form D in 2024. The bare 'Sutter Hill' also names a winery, a shopping centre, Sutter Health and a Sacramento property; the phrase layer keeps the firm's own entity names.

desks._note: One adviser, SUTTER HILL VENTURES, L.L.C. (IAPD CRD 162959, exempt reporting adviser 802-75145, 755 Page Mill Road, Suite A-200, Palo Alto; ADV annual amendment 2026-03-27). Its Section 7.B reports two private funds: Sutter Hill Ventures, A California Limited Partnership, and 1962 Opportunity Fund I, L.P. The partnership has invested since the 1960s; the Entrepreneurs Funds (AI, QP) and the Associates / Management GP entities are the same firm (decisions.md D1). External: Costanoa Venture Capital (Greg Sands's own firm from 2012, first housed at the same address), Bluebird Ventures (Jeff Bird's own vehicle), 1870 Embarcadero LP (a property partnership at the same address), and the Sutter namesakes.

profile._note: An exempt reporting adviser files no Item 5.F; the Section 7.B gross asset values of the two funds are the sworn figure. focus_min_companies is provisional, about 4.5% of the expected base.
